cells.scene: A streamlined express passenger train passes a small station at speed, platform empty and motion marks restrained.
An adult arrives at a meeting doorway exactly as the round wall clock points to nine, host ready to greet them.
A dog calmly sits at the familiar sound of a small hand bell, trainer holding the bell and reward nearby.
An adult stands steadfastly holding a small promise token despite two people trying to dissuade them, composed firm posture.

prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — express (n.快车 a.高速的): A streamlined express passenger train passes a small station at speed, platform empty and motion marks restrained.
TOP RIGHT — punctual (a.准时的): An adult arrives at a meeting doorway exactly as the round wall clock points to nine, host ready to greet them.
BOTTOM LEFT — condition (v.使习惯于): A dog calmly sits at the familiar sound of a small hand bell, trainer holding the bell and reward nearby.
BOTTOM RIGHT — unshakable (a.不可动摇的): An adult stands steadfastly holding a small promise token despite two people trying to dissuade them, composed firm posture.
EXTRA CROP SAFETY: Draw noticeably SMALLER compact subjects. Every object, mast, roof, thought bubble and entire person must have an empty white border of at least 12% of its quadrant on ALL FOUR sides. Top row ends above 44% canvas height; bottom row starts below 58%. Never let a background tower extend upward into the midline. No part is clipped by a quadrant edge.
review_notes: Reviewed course senses, expressive actions, natural anatomy, and white crop margins. Express is a fast train; condition shows a trained bell response; dislocate represents disruption of train services.
